title: Cars Without Petrol
paragraphs: An electric car does not need petrol. Instead, it has a large battery and an electric motor. The driver charges the battery by plugging the car into a charger. Electric cars are not new. Some were already on the roads more than a hundred years ago, but petrol cars soon became more popular.

Electric cars have some clear advantages. They produce no smoke from an exhaust pipe, so the air in busy cities can be cleaner. When the driver slows down, many electric cars can turn some of the movement back into electricity.

However, there are problems too. Charging a battery usually takes much longer than filling a tank with petrol. Finally, an electric car is only as clean as the electricity it uses. If that electricity comes from coal, the benefit is smaller.
